## Standard Report Structure (DO NOT MODIFY)

This is the **canonical structure** for all strategic planning executive reports. All future reports MUST follow this exact format.

### 1. Cover Page
**Design**: Full-screen gradient hero (purple #667eea → #764ba2)
**Content**:
- Company name (h1, 6xl, bold)
- Tagline/positioning statement (2xl, light)
- Report title: "Strategic Planning Executive Report"
- Subtitle: "Comprehensive Business Strategy & Financial Analysis"
- Location & launch date
- Strategic coherence score badge (green circle, centered)
- Report date & planning horizon

### 2. Table of Contents (No Print)
**Design**: White card with 2-column grid
**Sections** (anchor links):
1. Executive Summary
2. Market Opportunity Analysis
3. Customer Strategy
4. Competitive Positioning
5. Strategic Priorities (7 Pillars)
6. Financial Projections & Analysis
7. Q1 2026 Implementation Roadmap
8. Recommendations & Next Steps

### 3. Executive Summary
**Source**: `strategic-narrative.md` (lines 10-24)
**Content Blocks**:
- Opening paragraph (comprehensive business overview)
- Financial Opportunity Highlights (indigo callout box)
  - Year 1 Performance (4 metrics)
  - 3-Year Trajectory (4 metrics)
- Strategic Foundation paragraph (coherence score explanation)
- Critical Success Factors (4 cards in 2x2 grid)
- Go/No-Go Recommendation (green callout box)

### 4. Market Opportunity Analysis
**Source**: `strategic-narrative.md` (lines 26-96)
**Subsections**:
- Industry Growth & Trends
  - Cold therapy market overview (gray box)
  - 5 primary growth drivers (2 paragraphs)
  - COVID-19 impact (blue callout)
- San Diego Market Dynamics
  - Geographic opportunity stats
  - Competitive landscape
  - Consumer search behavior (SEO intelligence)
- Customer Pain Points & Unmet Needs (by ICP segment)

### 5. Customer Strategy
**Source**: `strategic-narrative.md` (section 2)
**Subsections**:
- ICP Segment #1: Performance Athletes (60%)
  - Purple background box
  - Demographics, psychographics, use case, LTV economics
- ICP Segment #2: Biohacking Executives (25%)
  - Blue background box
  - Full profile with ROI focus, corporate channel
- ICP Segment #3: Wellness Enthusiasts (15%)
  - Green background box
  - Retention challenges & mitigation
- Blended Unit Economics Dashboard (4 metric cards)

### 6. Competitive Positioning
**Source**: `strategic-narrative.md` (section 3)
**Subsections**:
- Competitive Score: 94/100 badge
- Four Core Differentiators (full paragraphs each):
  1. Facility Quality (largest Finnish sauna)
  2. Drop-In Convenience (no appointments, extended hours)
  3. Hospital-Grade Cleanliness (rigorous protocols)
  4. Exclusive Focus (specialists vs. generalists)
- Competitive Moat Building Strategy (short/medium/long-term)

### 7. Strategic Priorities (7 Pillars)
**Source**: `one-page-strategic-plan.md` (section 2, lines 129-171)
**Format**: Each priority gets full section with:
- Priority title (h3)
- "What This Means" paragraph (full explanation)
- Implementation tactics (bullet list)
- Success metrics
**7 Priorities**:
1. Launch Excellence
2. Operational Mastery
3. Membership Growth
4. Revenue Diversification
5. Community & Retention
6. Capacity Optimization
7. Brand Establishment

### 8. Financial Projections & Analysis
**Source**: `financial-projections.json`
**Subsections**:
- Unit Economics Dashboard (4 visual cards)
  - LTV:CAC Ratio
  - Payback Period
  - Customer LTV
  - Contribution Margin
- 24-Month Financial Runway (Chart.js)
  - Revenue (blue line)
  - EBITDA (green line)
  - Cash Position (orange line)
- Breakeven Analysis (narrative paragraph)
- Year 1 Financial Progression (narrative with milestones)
- Power of One Analysis (highest-leverage improvements table)
- 3-Year Trajectory Table

### 9. Q1 2026 Implementation Roadmap
**Source**: `one-page-strategic-plan.md` (section 3, lines 177-219)
**Subsections**:
- Pre-Launch Timeline (3 months detailed)
- 7 Quarterly Rocks (full descriptions):
  - Rock #1: Founding Member Success (complete paragraph)
  - Rock #2: Flawless Launch (detailed tactics)
  - Rocks #3-7: Full objectives & tactics
- Grid layout for rocks 3-7 with summaries

### 10. Recommendations & Next Steps
**Source**: Synthesized from strategic-narrative.md + OPSP
**Subsections**:
- Immediate Actions (Week 1: Dec 1-7)
  - 4 detailed categories with specific tasks
- 30-60-90 Day Strategic Priorities (full explanations)
- Success Metrics to Track Weekly (3 categories)
- Final Go/No-Go Recommendation (strategic strengths validation)

## Design System (CONSISTENT ACROSS ALL REPORTS)

### Colors
- **Primary Gradient**: `linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%)`
- **Accent Colors**:
  - Indigo: `#4F46E5` (financial highlights)
  - Blue: `#3B82F6` (market context)
  - Green: `#10B981` (recommendations, success)
  - Purple: `#8B5CF6` (athletes ICP)
  - Orange: `#F59E0B` (cash/financial)

### Typography
- **Font**: Inter (Google Fonts)
- **Hierarchy**:
  - H1: 6xl, bold (cover page only)
  - H2: 4xl, bold (main sections)
  - H3: 2xl, bold (subsections)
  - H4: xl, semibold (callout boxes)
  - Body: base, normal (gray-700)
  - Emphasis: semibold or bold

### Components
- **Cards**: White background, rounded-xl (12px), shadow-lg
- **Callout Boxes**: Colored background (x-50), border-l-4, padding 6
- **Metric Cards**: Border-2, hover effect (translateY -2px, border color change)
- **Section Headers**: Border-left 4px purple, padding-left 1rem
- **TOC Links**: Hover effect (background gray-50, padding-left 1rem)

### Layout
- **Max Width**: 7xl (1280px)
- **Padding**: px-6 (horizontal), py-12 (vertical)
- **Spacing**: space-y-12 between major sections
- **Grid**: md:grid-cols-2 for cards, gap-4 or gap-6

### Print Styles
- `.no-print` class hides table of contents
- `.page-break` class forces page break before major sections
- Background prints enabled (`print-color-adjust: exact`)

## How to Generate Reports

### Method 1: Using Existing Generator (Basic)
```bash
node orchestrai-domains/strategic-planning/tests/generate-html-report.js
```
**Limitations**: This generates the old basic report (charts only, no narrative)

### Method 2: Using Task Tool (Comprehensive) ✅ RECOMMENDED
```javascript
Task(
  subagent_type="general-purpose",
  prompt="Create comprehensive HTML executive report for [Client Name] using template structure from STRATEGIC-REPORT-TEMPLATE.md.

  Input files:
  - strategic-narrative.md (main content source)
  - financial-projections.json (for charts/data)
  - strategic-coherence-analysis.md (for coherence insights)
  - one-page-strategic-plan.md (for priorities and rocks)

  Follow exact template structure with all 10 sections.
  Include full narrative content, not just titles.
  Save to: /projects/[client-uuid]/deliverables/strategic-planning/comprehensive-strategic-report-[timestamp].html"
)
```

### Method 3: Future Automation (TODO)
**Goal**: Update `strategic-planning-pipeline.js` to automatically generate comprehensive HTML report in Stage 5.

**Implementation Plan**:

## Quality Checklist (Before Finalizing Report)

### Content Completeness
- [ ] Executive Summary has 4+ paragraphs (not just bullet points)
- [ ] All 7 Strategic Priorities have full descriptions (not just titles)
- [ ] All 7 Quarterly Rocks have complete objectives & tactics
- [ ] Financial section includes narrative analysis (not just chart)
- [ ] Market Opportunity section has 3+ subsections with full paragraphs
- [ ] Customer Strategy includes all 3 ICP segments with detailed profiles
- [ ] Recommendations section has specific, actionable next steps

### Visual Design
- [ ] Cover page displays correctly (gradient, coherence score badge)
- [ ] Table of contents links work (anchor navigation)
- [ ] Chart.js financial runway renders (3 lines visible)
- [ ] All callout boxes have proper colors (indigo, blue, green)
- [ ] Metric cards have hover effects
- [ ] Section headers have purple left border
- [ ] Print preview looks clean (no TOC, proper page breaks)

### Data Accuracy
- [ ] Strategic coherence score matches coherence-analysis.md
- [ ] Financial metrics match financial-projections.json
- [ ] ICP percentages match ICP analysis (60/25/15 split)
- [ ] Year 1 revenue projection matches financial model
- [ ] LTV:CAC ratio matches unit economics calculation
- [ ] All dates are consistent (launch date, planning horizon)
